title: Scalise says 'I don't know' why Trump banned three news outlets from WH
text:
House Majority Leader Steve Scalise (R-LA) pleaded ignorance when asked about President Donald Trump’s banning of three news outlets from the White House.

Speaking to ABC News’s This Week, Scalise was asked about Trump’s controversial move to ban CNN, MS Now, and Politico from the White House. In response, he said he was as in the dark as everyone else.
